joe_m: Hey team — started seeing HTTP/1.1 401 with {"error":"invalid_api_key"} this morning. I copied the key from the dashboard and it shows as active.

joe_m: curl I used:
curl -i -H 'Authorization: Bearer sess_abc123def456' \
  'https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate'

Response:
HTTP/1.1 401 {"error":"invalid_api_key"}

sara_support: Can you paste the exact Authorization header you sent (please mask full secret)?

joe_m: header was exactly as above. Noticed the token begins with "sess_". I thought API keys start with "rk_" though.

sara_support: Yep — that's the crux. Tokens prefixed with "sess_" are browser session tokens (short-lived) and aren't valid for API auth. API keys have the "rk_" prefix. Can you try copying the key from Console -> API keys (not the top-right quick-copy) and retry?

joe_m: Tried that just now. Copied a key starting with rk_9a8b... and re-ran the same curl (replaced header) — got 200 OK. So that fixed it. The copy button on the dashboard home had copied a different token earlier (the sess_ one).

sara_support: Great, thanks for confirming. I'm escalating because the copy control on the overview page seems ambiguous and may be targeting the session token in some states. @alex_eng can you take a look? I have the failed request id: x-request-id: req_01FJYABCDEFG.

alex_eng: On it. Can you share exact repro steps (browser + flow)? Also, if you can, paste the DOM tree around the copy icon (or the CSS selector) — helpful but not required.

joe_m: Chrome 118 on macOS. Steps: Login -> Dashboard home (the overview with quick stats) -> click small copy icon in the header (top-right) -> paste into terminal. That produced the sess_ token.

sara_support: Added the request id and a short repro note to the ticket.

alex_eng: I reproduced locally. The copy control on /dashboard/home currently reads window.__REDWOOD_SESSION.token when the quick-token widget is rendered, instead of reading window.__REDWOOD_API_KEYS[0].secret. Filed internal issue RED-3421 and opened a small PR to change the selector and add an E2E test. Will try to include in tomorrow's deploy.

joe_m: Fantastic — appreciate the quick help :pray:

deploy-bot: deploy RED-3421 to staging succeeded — build 202.

alex_eng: We'll keep this thread updated when we schedule prod rollout. If anyone else hits this, ask them to copy the key from Console -> API keys as a workaround.
